investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Section 25A(1) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that references to a transit shed are to a place approved:-
(a) under section 25 of the Act or
(b) under Article 51 of Council Regulation (EEC) No 2913/92 (equivalent provision for goods on or after 1st January 1992 from a place outside the customs territory of the European Union).
